hooks.name: Spec Completion Check
hooks.description: When a spec task is marked complete, checks if all tasks in the spec are done and prompts for PDR absorption

action.prompt:
A spec task was just marked complete. Check if ALL tasks in the spec's tasks.md are now checked `[x]`. 

If all tasks are complete:
1. Announce: "🎉 Spec complete! All tasks in {spec-name} are done."
2. Ask: "Ready to absorb this spec into a PDR? Run: `python3 scripts/absorb-spec-to-pdr.py {spec-name}`"

If tasks remain:
- Silently continue (don't interrupt workflow)
